shots.action: Rain beads and streaks down a bus window at night; beyond the glass, blurred city lights and reflected signage slide slowly sideways as the vehicle moves.
shots.what_changes: Droplets merge into wavering trails and the out-of-focus light streaks drift across the frame.

shots.action: A single large drop trembles at the centre of the glass, then slides diagonally, collecting smaller droplets and stretching the neon reflections into warped ribbons behind it.
shots.what_changes: The central drop swells, breaks loose, and drags the reflected light into long distorted bands.
